newsitem.title: USA: Hilton New Orleans Riverside hotel open.
newsitem.headline: Hilton New Orleans Riverside hotel open.

text.p: Hilton Hotels Corp said on Sunday apart from a small percentage of guest rooms, its New Orleans Riverside hotel was undamaged and operational, after a freighter collided with a shopping area near the hotel.

A ship accidentally rammed into the New Orleans Riverwalk shopping mall overlooking the Mississippi River on Saturday. The New Orleans mayor said no deaths had been confirmed after the freighter lost power and plowed into the mall, destroying 15 shops and restaurants and injuring at least 116 people.
"Except for a small percentage of guest rooms, the 1,600-room hotel was undamaged, is operational and is open for business," Hilton said, about its hotel there.

"At this point, it appears that a small number of guest rooms will be out of service for an indefinite period of time, and that our adjacent riverboat casino is likely to remain closed for a short time," Stephen Bollenbach, president and chief executive officer of Hilton Hotels, said.
